import os, sys
os.environ['JAX_PLATFORMS'] = 'cpu'
os.environ['XLA_FLAGS'] = '--xla_force_host_platform_device_count=4'
os.environ['CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES'] = ''

import numpy as np
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib as mpl
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats as sp_stats

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath('.')), 'root', 'gated_mfrm_judge_bias', 'mvp'))
sys.path.insert(0, '/root/gated_mfrm_judge_bias/mvp')
from data_gen import generate_gated_mfrm_data
from models import fit_sequential

PAPER_STYLE = {
    'font.family': 'serif',
    'font.serif': ['Times New Roman', 'DejaVu Serif'],
    'font.size': 10,
    'axes.labelsize': 12,
    'axes.titlesize': 12,
    'xtick.labelsize': 10,
    'ytick.labelsize': 10,
    'legend.fontsize': 10,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'axes.grid': True,
    'grid.alpha': 0.3,
    'grid.linestyle': '--',
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'pdf.fonttype': 42,
    'ps.fonttype': 42,
}
mpl.rcParams.update(PAPER_STYLE)

COLORS = {'sequential': '#e41a1c', 'joint': '#377eb8'}

N, I, J, rho, n_seeds = 50, 100, 8, 0.6, 20
all_c, all_bias = [], []
for seed in range(n_seeds):
    print(f'  seed {seed}/{n_seeds}', flush=True)
    data = generate_gated_mfrm_data(N=N, I=I, J=J, rho=rho, seed=seed)
    theta_true = data['true_params']['theta']
    theta_true_c = theta_true - theta_true.mean()
    c_true = data['true_params']['c']
    e_values = data['true_params']['e']
    seq = fit_sequential(data, e_values)
    bias = seq['theta_hat'] - theta_true_c
    all_c.extend(c_true.tolist())
    all_bias.extend(bias.tolist())

all_c = np.array(all_c)
all_bias = np.array(all_bias)
r, p = sp_stats.pearsonr(all_c, all_bias)
print(f'  Pearson r={r:.4f}, p={p:.2e}')

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(3.5, 2.8))
ax.scatter(all_c, all_bias, alpha=0.35, s=12, c=COLORS['sequential'],
           edgecolors='none', zorder=2)
ax.axhline(0, color='gray', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.6)

z = np.polyfit(all_c, all_bias, 1)
x_line = np.linspace(all_c.min(), all_c.max(), 100)
ax.plot(x_line, np.polyval(z, x_line), color='#222222', linewidth=1.8,
        label=f'\$r = {r:.2f}\$', zorder=3)

ax.set_xlabel(r'\$c_n\$ (true contamination susceptibility)')
ax.set_ylabel(r'\$\\hat{\\theta}_{\\mathrm{seq}} - \\theta_{\\mathrm{true}}\$')
ax.legend(loc='upper left', framealpha=0.9)
ax.set_axisbelow(True)
fig.tight_layout()

# Save to both locations
for outdir in ['/root/figures/paper', '/root/gated_mfrm_judge_bias/paper']:
    os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)
    for ext in ['pdf', 'png']:
        fig.savefig(os.path.join(outdir, f'fig2_ovb_bias.{ext}'), dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
        print(f'  Saved: {outdir}/fig2_ovb_bias.{ext}')

plt.close(fig)
print('Done.')
"
